stem_book: Find the number of forces acting in the F.B.D. of block 'A': block m₁ rests on block m₂ (= block A), which rests on the ground; the m₁–m₂ interface is rough and the m₂–ground interface is rough; a horizontal force F is applied to the upper block m₁. (Count normal force and friction at each contact as separate forces.)
correct_answer: 5 (weight, N from m₁, friction from m₁, N from ground, friction from ground)
reason: Counting convention (N and f separate) added so the count is unambiguous.
work: m₂g + N₁ (by m₁) + f₁ (by m₁) + N₂ (ground) + f₂ (ground) = 5
